preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) >= 1 and len(row) <= 500 for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have a length between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell == 0 or cell == 1 for cell in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either 0 (sea) or 1 (land).

postconditions.description: The number of enclaves must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(1, len(grid) - 1) for j in range(1, len(grid[0]) - 1) if grid[i][j] == 1 and not can_walk_off_boundary(grid, i, j))
postconditions.description: The number of enclaves is the count of land cells that cannot walk off the boundary.
